draw_order: per member j in index order: clip(centre + rng.normal(0, area/10, 2), 0, area)
event_law.timing: applied inside step() of the call with current_step == t_e, before that call's actions; series index t_e is the first post-event value; every rule reacts from its decision for step t_e (full information)

rng_derivations.planner: numpy.random.default_rng(world), fresh instance per search (D2 run_gate rule), for the pre-event, cold and seeded searches

windows.cross_world: per-world window means first, then equal-weight means across worlds; paired SDs over per-world differences

definitions.S_switch: warm - keep (post-event C_bh, per world, then paired across worlds)
definitions.S_cold: warm - cold (post-event C_bh, per world, then paired across worlds)
definitions.transition_loss_steps: post-event steps with C_bh below the world's pre-event mean
definitions.arrival_step: first step >= t_e at which every UAV sat on the rule's final targets
definitions.S_seeded: seeded - keep (post-event C_bh, per world, then paired across worlds)
definitions.warm: held re-placement only (non-movable UAVs keep their targets); empty movable set -> single-UAV fallback at 500 evaluations per candidate, adopted only above the held layout's static reward, else warm == KEEP
definitions.seeded: cold relay search seeded with the pre-event sites; all UAVs may move
